newsitem.title: USA: Rural/Metro gets Tenn. contract renewal.
newsitem.headline: Rural/Metro gets Tenn. contract renewal.

text.p: Rural/Metro Corp on Thursday said it has received a three-year renewal of its 911 ambulance services contract in Knox County, Tenn., after the completion of a competitive process.

The firm said it also landed two other unique contracts that leverage its core competency in communications. Under one contract, the firm will manage a new, consolidated 911 communication center in Northampton County, Pa.

The other contract, with Bartizan American Communications, integrates 24-hour monitoring and dispatch services with the Motorola Inc cellular telephone and global positioning system for automobiles, thus creating a new, nationwide automotive safety and security monitoring network.
Financial details of the contracts were not disclosed.

The company also noted that its prevoiously announced merger with private ambulance company Southwest Ambulance is expected to initially contribute about $30 million of annualized ambulance services revenue.

Earlier, the firm said that 1997 third quarter net income per share rose to $0.38, compared with $0.31 on fewer shares for the previous year. Average shares outstanding increased 25 percent over the third quarter of fiscal 1996.
